result.title: ReelCache: An Efficient KV Cache Compression and Management System for Multi-Round Video Generation
result.comment: 18 pages total, 11 pages body plus 5 pages appendix
result.summary: Autoregressive video diffusion models produce large KV caches during multi-round video generation. Keeping all these KV chunks would consume substantial memory, while rebuilding discarded caches would significantly delay video chunk generation. This paper presents ReelCache, a KV cache compression system for efficient multi-round, long video generation. ReelCache combines an intra-chunk compressor with an inter-chunk cache manager. The compressor applies low-rank decomposition across channels and video coding to the resulting coefficients, predicting the decomposition rank per transformer layer online to meet retained-energy targets. The cache manager shares basis directions across consecutive chunks and organizes chunk states in a tree, allowing generation branches to share historical state while supporting restoration for resume, rewind, and fork. Experiments across five video generation models show that ReelCache reduces KV storage by 14.46-21.13x relative to baselines and accelerates next-chunk generation by 1.25-3.36x, with less than 1% drop in six representative VBench metrics. GitHub: https://github.com/Tianyu9748/ReelCache

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 ReelCache，面向多轮长视频生成，用层内低秩分解加视频编码压缩 KV cache，并按层在线预测分解秩，同时用跨 chunk 共享基与树状 cache 管理支持恢复与分叉，报告 14–21 倍存储压缩和 1.25–3.36 倍加速。
AI.relevance_reason: 视频生成本身不在主线，但其按层能量目标选择压缩秩、跨段共享基与树状状态复用/回溯机制，或可供核查 LVR 中 latent 状态缓存的压缩保真、深度与位置差异及分支轨迹复用问题。
